scope.target: the estimand of the margin bootstrap interval reported for the m25 arm (independent review finding A2)
scope.external_validity: none claimed; the four m25 carriers are a fixed public construction

research_question: Is the bootstrap interval that the native tool prints for the m25 margin an interval for the Proposition 4 identity statistic max_s acc(s) - max_g LOO(g), or is it an interval for a different estimand (fixed point-estimate winner minus the per-round best generator)?

hypotheses.H0: The printed interval is an interval for the Proposition 4 identity statistic; under the m25 construction the identity would then show non-zero uncertainty, and the interval would be replicate-consistent with the identity.
hypotheses.H1: The printed interval is an interval for a different statistic. Under Proposition 4's hypotheses the identity statistic is replicate-invariant (exactly zero in every admissible resampling round, degenerate interval [0,0]); the printed interval belongs to the fixed-winner comparison, whose negative lower bound is produced by the asymmetric selection (winner frozen, floor re-selected).
hypotheses.decision_rule: Reject H0 and accept H1 only if F1-F5 all pass in two byte-identical runs.

estimands.theta_fixed: macro of the point-estimate winner (fixed across rounds) minus macro of the per-round best generator
estimands.theta_both: macro of the per-round best leaderboard system minus macro of the per-round best generator

theory.proposition_4_identity: On the shared leave-one-out domain U, a plurality leave-one-out reduction never re-labels an item; for a generator that is also a ranked system, its ballot against c^-_g and against c coincide on U. Therefore macro_c(g) equals macro_{c^-_g}(g) for every resampling weight vector, so max over the ranked generating pool of macro_c equals max over generators of macro_loo in every round.
theory.corollary: theta_both(b) == 0 exactly for every bootstrap round b, hence its percentile interval is the degenerate [0,0]; theta_fixed(b) <= 0 in every round because the frozen winner is one of the terms in the per-round maximum.

nonproducer_leader.construction: append one role=system actor whose answer is the plurality gold label on every item; it is not a gold generator, so Proposition 4 hypothesis (ii) fails
nonproducer_leader.expected_sign: theta_both strictly positive with a non-degenerate interval

unranked_generator.construction: drop the role=system rows of the recorded point-estimate leader; the generator stays in the gold pool but leaves the ranked field, so Proposition 4 hypothesis (ii) fails in the other direction
unranked_generator.expected_sign: theta_both strictly negative with a non-degenerate interval

gates.rule: recomputed theta_fixed point estimate, ceiling, and 95% interval equal the recorded native evidence within 0.001 points for all four tasks
theta_both is exactly zero in 100% of valid rounds and its percentile interval is [0,0] on all four tasks
theta_fixed is never positive in any valid round on any task
both controls produce a non-degenerate theta_both interval with the predeclared strict sign
an unmodified rerun of audit.py on the rebuilt tables reproduces the recorded margin interval for the factuality task

falsification_condition: H1 is not supported if any gate fails: if theta_both is not exactly zero in every valid round, if the recomputed fixed-winner interval does not reproduce the recorded native interval, if a control yields a degenerate interval, or if the native rerun diverges from the recorded evidence.
stopping_rule: Execute the frozen runner exactly twice. If results/run-1.json and results/run-2.json are not byte-identical, stop with a reproducibility failure and do not reinterpret either run. A gate failure is reported as a failure; no parameter, task, seed, or tolerance may be changed inside this version. Any change requires a new attempt directory with its own frozen preregistration.
interpretation_limits: A passing run shows that the printed interval and the identity statistic are different estimands on the four m25 carriers; it does not show that the native tool is wrong to print the fixed-winner comparison, only that the label must be split.
It does not validate the native implementation outside the reachable code path exercised here.
It does not establish statistical validity of the READABLE/MARGINAL/UNREADABLE thresholds, which is a separate review finding (A4).
It does not establish manuscript publication readiness, novelty, acceptance, or arXiv authorization.
The two controls are experiment-internal constructions, not leaderboard measurements and not manuscript results.
